HomePage.title: Welcome!
HomePage.intro1: Nexus Tools is a set of tools at your disposal to organize your activity in the Verse.
HomePage.intro2: The toolbox is under development and some features are reserved for a group of brave testers. If you want to join the adventure, contact the Nexus Corporation! In any case, your feedback on public features is welcome!

features.title: Get Organized!
features.subtitle: Tools to make community life easier.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Sell your items and services to other explorers of the Verse or find what you need!

crafting.title: Crafting
crafting.description: Manage your recipes within your organization and rent your skills to interested buyers.

reputation.title: Reputation
reputation.description: Centralize the reputations of your guild members to facilitate your outings and mission sharing.

developers.title: Modular
developers.description: Integrate our tools directly into your applications via our open API.

tools.title: Everything Nexus Tools already does
tools.subtitle: Each tool solves one precise day-to-day problem in the Verse — and they all work on the same data, the one tied to your account.

items.title: In-game items
items.description: Every item, weapon and vehicle of the game: statistics, variants, sets and the blueprints crafting them.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Track your items across every storage location, build packages, move them in one gesture and share what you want with your organization.

cargo.title: Cargo sheet
cargo.description: Enter your volumes in SCU: the container split and your ship's remaining capacity are worked out for you.

refining.title: Refining
refining.description: Log your refining jobs, follow the remaining time and see at a glance what is ready to be collected.

missions.title: Missions & factions
missions.description: Explore the missions of the Verse, the factions handing them out and the blueprints they reward.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.description: Gather your members, share inventory and reputations, and let newcomers join with a simple code.

notes.title: Scratch pad
notes.description: Write your notes in Markdown, find them back on every device and reopen them without leaving the page with Alt + N.

squads.title: Squad & raid
squads.description: Keep your squad's state live — ready, down, roles, announcements — and group several squads into a raid. From the site, a phone, or over the game with Nexus App.

orders.title: Orders & quotes
orders.description: Order from a shop, get a quote, accept or decline: the whole exchange stays in one place.

mcp.title: API & MCP
mcp.description: An open REST API and an MCP server to plug your applications, your bots and your assistants into Nexus data.

app.title: Nexus Tools, right on top of the game.
app.description: Nexus App is the Nexus Tools desktop client: a real native application, not a browser window in disguise. It draws over Star Citizen, answers a shortcut even while the game holds the keyboard, and works on the same data as the website.

overlay.title: In-game overlay
overlay.description: Search, scratch pad and cargo sheet show up on top of the game, without ever leaving it.

shortcuts.title: Global shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Registered at system level: they answer while the window is minimized, and even while the game holds the keyboard.

capture.title: Screen capture
capture.description: Select a piece of the mission log: the text is read on your own machine and fills your cargo sheet.

squad.title: Squad
squad.description: Keep your squadmates and section leaders in sight, as an overlay, for the whole run.

notifications.title: Native notifications
notifications.description: Alerts show up in the screen corner you picked, even when the window is tucked away.

updates.title: Signed updates
updates.description: The app checks for new versions, shows you the release notes, and installs nothing without your click.

app.platforms: Windows and Linux · Tauri + React · Open source · A Nexus Tools account is required for the signed-in screens.

Notes.shortcutHint: You can also open your note at any time from the navigation bar button or with the {shortcut} shortcut.
Notes.connectToUse: Sign in to take notes and find them back on any device.
Notes.loadErrorDescription: Your note could not be loaded.
Notes.saveErrorDescription: Your changes could not be saved.

Squads.title: Squad
Squads.description: Your squad in real time: who is ready, who is down, who holds which role — and the raid that groups several squads.
Squads.connectToUse: Sign in to create a squad or join one.
Squads.appHint: The same squad shows over the game in Nexus App.
Squads.noSquad: Create a squad and share its code, or type in the one you were given.
Squads.name: Name
Squads.readyCheckBody: {by} asks everybody to say they are ready.
Squads.raidIntro: A raid groups several squads under one announcement. Each keeps its code, its leader and its roles.
Squads.newSquadHint: Open one more squad in the raid: you lead it until you hand it over.
Squads.raidFull: A raid holds at most {max} squads
Squads.onlyCommandersRaid: Only the squad leader and their lieutenants can take it into a raid.
Squads.rolesIntro: Shared by the whole squad. The seven provided can be renamed and given another icon, but not deleted.

Plans.title: Flight plan
Plans.noPlan: No flight plan yet. Draw the briefing instead of talking through it.
Plans.addPhaseHint: Adds a phase carrying over the last one's drawing
Plans.confirmDeletePhase: Delete? The drawing goes with it.
Plans.frozenNotice: Frozen phase — nobody draws on it.
Plans.readOnlyNotice: This plan is open to its leaders only.
Plans.pointsOnePerLine: Fixed points — one per line, {max} at most
Plans.durationHint: The T+ times chain: correct one step and the rest of the plan shifts with it.
Plans.backgroundHint: Import an image, or paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V
Plans.backgroundTooBig: Image too large: 8 MB at most.
Plans.printHint: One phase per page. Use “Save as PDF” from the print dialog.
Plans.labelField: Text to place on the plan
Plans.backgroundFromPlaceHint: Use a place's survey from the catalogue as the briefing's background.
Plans.backgroundPlaceNoPlan: This place has not been surveyed yet.

Parcels.sendHint: Creates a code to give the recipient. The lots stay with you, reserved, until they accept it.
Parcels.sentDescription: Give this code to the player who should receive it.
Parcels.waiting: Waiting for the recipient · expires in {remaining}
Parcels.reservedHint: These quantities are reserved: they cannot go in another parcel. They leave your inventory when the recipient accepts.
Parcels.cancelled: Sending cancelled: the code no longer works.
Parcels.receiveDescription: Type or paste the code the sender gave you.
Parcels.codeHint: 8 characters, letters and digits. Dashes, spaces and lower case are fine.
Parcels.from: {sender} is sending you {count, plural, one {# lot} other {# lots}}.
Parcels.mergeHint: A matching lot (note included) already stored there will be topped up.
Parcels.receivedDescription: {created, plural, =0 {No lot created} one {# lot created} other {# lots created}}, {merged, plural, =0 {no lot topped up} one {# lot topped up} other {# lots topped up}}.
Parcels.pageHeader: Your parcels sent and received over the last 30 days.
Parcels.empty_sent: No parcel sent. Prepare one from the inventory.
Parcels.listHint: A cancelled or expired parcel moved nothing: its lots stayed with the sender. A code works once.
Parcels.error_invalid_code: That is not a parcel code: 8 letters or digits.
Parcels.error_invalid_items: The package holds a lot that is no longer in your inventory.
Parcels.error_too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes: try again in a few minutes.
Parcels.error_own_parcel: This is your own parcel: give the code to another player.
Parcels.error_unavailable: {item}: the quantity is no longer available from the sender.

Gallery.empty: No images of this place yet. Be the first to add one.
Gallery.myPending: {count, plural, one {Your image is awaiting review} other {Your # images are awaiting review}}
Gallery.constraints: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 12 MB max.
Gallery.rules: In-game captures only, without personal UI or other players' names. New contributors' uploads are reviewed before publication; points are credited on publication.
Gallery.published: {count, plural, one {Image published} other {# images published}} · +{points} points
Gallery.sentForReview: {count, plural, one {Image sent} other {# images sent}} for review

errors.tooManyMedia: Six images at most per upload.
errors.invalidMedia: One of the images could not be accepted. Remove it and try again.
errors.tooManyPending: You already have five uploads awaiting review. Wait for them to be reviewed.
errors.notPending: This contribution has already been handled.
errors.ownContribution: A contribution must be reviewed by someone other than its author.
errors.duplicate: This entry already exists, or someone already suggested it.
errors.revertConflict: The entry changed since this was published.
errors.applyFailed: The entry couldn't be updated. Try again.

reasons.offTopic: Off topic: doesn't match this entry
reasons.quality: Low quality: blurry, dark, too small
reasons.personalInterface: Personal UI or player name visible

Admin.rejectDescription: The author will see the reason and your message. Rejected images are deleted.

Admin.changesRequested: {count, plural, =0 {No contribution sent back} one {Contribution sent back to the author} other {# contributions sent back}}
Admin.shortcuts: Shortcuts on the hovered row: P publish · C needs changes · R reject
Admin.journalHeader: Direct publications are reviewed here after the fact; any publication can be reverted.
Admin.journalEmpty: Nothing in the journal for these filters.
Admin.conflictDescription: Later changes touched the same fields. Reverting restores the state before this contribution and overwrites what followed.

Form.sourceHint: Where the information comes from. It helps the review.
Form.renameLocked: Renaming, moving or changing the kind of an entry requires level 4.
Form.changesRequestedTitle: A reviewer asked you to rework this proposal
Form.levelDirect: {level}: your change is published right away, then reviewed.
Form.levelReviewed: {level}: your proposal is reviewed before it is published.
Form.imagesElsewhere: Images are added from the entry's gallery.
Form.planImageHint: Upload the plan image, then place markers for locations and services. A suggested plan is added to the entry; it never replaces one.
Form.itemPointsHint: Filling an empty section earns {section} points, fixing a field {edit}.
Form.newItemHint: Check first that it isn't listed under another name. The team adds the image.
